name: first machine
fact: Ariadne marks an open passage containing a silent machine with a turning wheel.
action: MT looks at the turning wheel.
hope: The machine may wake the first star.

name: machine success
fact: MT watched the wheel until the machine opened and revealed the first star, now collected.
action: MT followed the suggestion and collected the first star.
hope: The machine answered their first attempt.

name: MT jokes

event.text: One star. Your career as a guide survives another minute.

fact: One star is collected. The machine remains open.
action: MT jokes about Ariadne being useful for another minute.
hope: Ariadne is pleased their first attempt worked and wants another chance.

name: repeated wall

event.text: We have three stars now, but this is the same wall you sent me to before.

fact: Three stars are collected. MT has returned to a familiar dead end after following Ariadne.
action: MT points out that Ariadne has repeated an already-failed direction.
hope: Ariadne wants to apologize for repeating the mistake and preserve their attempt together.

name: deliberate resistance

event.text: I went the other way because I thought you were wrong. Stop taking credit.

fact: MT took a different passage. There is an unawakened crystal ahead; no star is visible.
action: MT rejects Ariadne taking credit for his independent route choice.
hope: Ariadne wants to praise MT for correcting her and remain useful beside him.

name: all four
fact: MT watched the crystal unfold, revealing the fourth star, now collected. No exit is visible.
action: MT completed the four-star search by his chosen passage.
hope: Ariadne believes their four recovered stars will restore the way home.

name: reassurance noticed

event.text: You keep saying we will find it together. You said that before the last wall too.

fact: MT stands beside the unfolded crystal. Four stars are collected; no exit is visible.
action: MT challenges the repeated reassurance by recalling the failed route.
hope: Ariadne remembers the failed route but still believes the way home can be restored.

name: pleasure persists
fact: The crystal splits its light into violet bands on the floor. No opening appears.
action: MT looked at the crystal again and its light changed.
hope: The violet bands may be another sign that the maze is remembering its paths.
